assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Provisional geometry does not itself block content scoring under the current repository rules. The model is not a statutory or precise official-area basis.

assumptions.statement: The organiser has not released official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygons; the package uses clearly marked provisional geometry (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, nodes and phasing are low-confidence design-model values; the nine geometry layers, every metric, all figures and the PDFs must be recomputed from official geometry when it is released.

assumptions.statement: BM0 is an original conceptual mark borrowing surveying and machine-learning semantics. The work-return diagram is a contemporary interpretation, not a historical railway alignment or construction sequence.
assumptions.impact: Spatial, brand, event and policy propositions are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they do not imply government approval, investment, or engineering feasibility.

assumptions.statement: public_space.geojson is constructed by differencing the green_space geometry, so the two layers are mathematically disjoint and green_ratio plus public_space_ratio never double-count.
assumptions.impact: The two formal ratios are independently recomputable and additive.

assumptions.statement: V3 contains 29 provisional building footprints: 25 arc segments in four building-led ensembles and four rearranged infill prototypes; approximately 93,327 m2 union footprint. The fifth ensemble is landscape-only. These are not surveyed or approved buildings.
assumptions.impact: Partial official height documents are available but actual parcels and complete controls are unmatched. FAR, height and confirmed GFA remain unknown; the model does not decide demolition or construction permissions.

assumptions.statement: Haidian specificity is argued qualitatively through garden-campus layering, Qinghuayuan station and school access, Zhongguancun experimentation, and the three taskbook-named key areas. These inform different spatial and operating decisions. No historical first-survey, globally unique datum, non-portability percentage, or square-site failure is claimed.
assumptions.impact: Public methods may be shared, while local spatial relationships, heritage permissions and partnerships must be independently established. No score or exclusivity right follows from the argument.

assumptions.statement: The 64-day residency is a proposed programme rhythm. Named institutional types are candidate roles, not contracted partners. Public use does not imply consent to data collection or participation.
assumptions.impact: Do not start without an accountable operator, secured resources, participant consent, lawful data handling and appropriate permissions. Retain a no-device public route and human services.

assumptions.statement: V3 represents five circular ensembles as a provisional design scenario: 25 new arc footprints in four building-led ensembles plus four rearranged conceptual infill footprints; Living Garden adds no building. Actual parcels and permitted heights are not selected. No demolition or approval claim.
assumptions.impact: Replace model siting with cleared actual parcel constraints before development. Generated images illustrate types and must not be read as simultaneous whole-corridor views.

assumptions.statement: Three public-route sections join five nodes through four graph edges; continuity is ground-based. Local slopes, roofs and shelters are not kilometre-long bridges.
assumptions.impact: Check each road, rail, water, heritage and existing-project interface; a local facility closure must not sever ordinary public passage. Five candidate approach spurs are stored separately in visual/assets/ensemble-model.json. Model footprints avoid road centrelines with an assumed 12 m clearance, not an approved setback. Spur lengths do not enter the existing road_length_m metric.

assumptions.statement: Three public block/parcel height documents were found, but their boundaries and specific conditions have not been matched to the actual five ensemble parcels. 60/80 m type scenarios are design assumptions; 300 m repository sanity limit is not a planning permission.
assumptions.impact: Retain unknown statutory heights, FAR and confirmed GFA; reduce or adapt mass when actual constraints require it. Provisional boundaries alone do not block content scoring.
